$comment: Repo-tracked cutover readiness gate. See docs/adr/003-sluice-cutover-readiness.md. This file is read by cutover-readiness.ts/.test.ts, which fail the build if it drifts from reality without a deliberate update. Do not hand-edit `readyForCutover` to true without also closing every remaining `it.todo` in sluice-routerlicious.test.ts and updating the ADR.
notes: expectedOutstandingTodoCount must equal the number of `it.todo(` calls in the conformance suite. When a gap is closed, update this count (and remove the corresponding it.todo) in the same change. readyForCutover only flips to true once expectedOutstandingTodoCount is 0 for both required targets AND the Phoenix-owned surfaces above have been ported or explicitly re-scoped.
